mapper.sql: SELECT r.id , r.employee_id , r.start_of_the_day , r.entry , r.exit , r.break_time , r.back_to_work , r.day , r.justification_id FROM register r
mapper.select: WHERE (#{id} IS NULL OR r.id = #{id}) AND (#{employeeId} IS NULL OR r.employee_id = #{employeeId}) AND (#{day} IS NULL OR r.day = #{day})
